name: Le Monarque

frame.name: Poison Arrows
frame.description: Arrows fired while perfectly drawn become poison arrows. Precision hits with poison arrows stun the combatant and spread poison to nearby ones. Strong against [Disruption] Overload Champions.

perks.name: Natural String
perks.description:
Simple balanced string.
  •  Slightly increases accuracy
  •  Slightly increases handling speed
  •  Slightly increases stability

perks.name: Compact Arrow Shaft
perks.description:
Thinner arrows to increase nocking speed and weapon handling.
  •  Increases handling speed 
  •  Increases reload speed

perks.name: Snapshot Sights
perks.description: Faster time to aim down sights.

flavor: "Wings flutter. Beauty distracts. Poison injects. The butterfly's curse extends to your enemies. A short life, shortened further by your hand." —Ada-1

catalyst.name: Le Monarque Catalyst
catalyst.description: Rapidly defeating targets triggers health regeneration. Guardians and powerful combatants count as more than one kill.
